summary: The state is sealed to 2 readers. Attributes, outputs and stored plans are encrypted. Addresses, types, names, dependencies and revisions stay readable, so the graph and the plans keep working.

file.text: The readers file matches the store.

recovery.text: Recovery: any 3 of 5 shares rebuild the recovery key (x25519:7rDj4D…). If every reader loses their key, the holders of 3 shares can open the state.
recovery.warning: The lock of the recovery key is missing from g1. The repository has no recovery file, so a writer cannot tell that the recovery was taken out of the bucket.

suggestions.title: Add a reader
suggestions.why: The new reader makes an identity and sends the line it prints. A current reader adds the line, commits it and rewraps.
suggestions.who: the new reader, then a current reader

suggestions.title: Remove ada
suggestions.why: Removing the line stops new records being sealed to ada. ada keeps what they already read, and an old copy of the bucket still opens with their key. Replace the real secrets ada could read where they live.

steps.text: You are not a reader once this has run. A reader who is left runs the rest, which seals every existing record again under the new key:

suggestions.title: Remove dan
suggestions.why: Removing the line stops new records being sealed to dan. dan keeps what they already read, and an old copy of the bucket still opens with their key. Replace the real secrets dan could read where they live.

steps.text: rewrap --all seals every existing record again under the new key.
